name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Patryk Jaki
part_text:
The European Parliament has agreed to lift the legal protection from prosecution that Patryk Jaki, a Polish member, holds as an elected representative. A court in Warsaw wants to try him over statements he made in June 2024 about a judge, including a claim that the judge allowed the use of Pegasus spy software. The court says he slandered the judge. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to harm his political work.

- Polish court can now pursue its criminal case against Patryk Jaki.
- Affects Patryk Jaki, the Polish member of the European Parliament.
- Parliament's President sends the decision to the Warsaw court and to Jaki.
